data.name: Kumaresan
data.gender_notes: Kumaresan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the god of prosperity, wealth and success. This name is derived from the Tamil word 'kumar' meaning youth and 'esan' meaning god. The name Kumaresan carries the meaning “God of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Kumaresan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the divine presence of the deity within an individual, bestowing them with the blessings of prosperity, wealth and success.
data.etymology: Kumaresan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kumaresan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kumaresan represents the rich cultural heritage of Hinduism, where gods and goddesses are revered and their names hold significant power and meaning. By bestowing a child with this name, the parents are expressing their deep faith in the Hindu deity Kumar (Baby Krishna or Subramania) and their hope for their child's prosperity, wealth, and success in life.
data.spiritual_significance: Kumaresan is a name infused with spiritual meaning, as it signifies the divine blessings of the god of prosperity and success. It represents a deep connection to the Hindu faith and a belief that every aspect of life is governed by the grace of the divine. The name serves as a constant reminder for the child to strive for success and wealth, but also to remain humble, grateful, and faithful to the divine throughout their journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kumaresan: God's warrior. The name Kumaresan signifies a devotee deeply committed to serving and protecting the divine will, embodying the strength and valiance of a warrior in the path of righteousness.

historical_references.reference: Kumaresan was a renowned Tamil poet and scholar in the 12th century. He was a disciple of the famous poet-saint Thirugnana Sambandar and contributed significantly to the Tevaram anthology, a collection of hymns dedicated to Lord Shiva.

Kumaresan is also known for his contributions to the Agama texts, a body of sacred texts in medieval Hinduism that provide instructions for the performance of various rituals and ceremonies. He authored several works, including the 'Tirumurai', a commentary on the Agama texts.
